message.content: A penis is a male reproductive organ that serves both urinary and reproductive functions. It typically consists of three main parts: the root (attached to the pelvic wall), the shaft (the elongated portion), and the glans (the rounded tip). The shaft contains erectile tissue that becomes engorged during sexual arousal, allowing for erection. The glans is usually covered by a fold of skin called the foreskin in uncircumcised individuals; otherwise, it is exposed. The urethra runs through the center of the shaft, carrying urine out of the body and semen during ejaculation.
